decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable and portable waterproof Bluetooth speaker. I filtered out several items in the feed that were actually carrying cases rather than speakers (id 053, 175, 014). My consideration set includes a mix of premium aesthetics (JBL Pulse 4), reliable brand-name value (renewed JBL Charge 4), and highly-rated budget options. I selected the Altec Lansing Mini H2O as my final choice because it is exceptionally affordable at $25.35, boasts over 15,000 reviews with a 4.4 rating, and offers the rugged IP67 waterproof certification I need for outdoor use.
